info.title: Orbit Customer Context Provider
info.summary: Read-only, product-neutral customer context for Orbit Support.
info.description:
Implemented by a product (or by n8n in front of it) and called by Orbit for `customer_context.read`.

See ADR 0011 and docs/CUSTOMER_CONTEXT.md. Orbit sends only verified identities.

Bodies are at most 65536 bytes; Orbit waits at most 8000 ms.

Signature: `X-Orbit-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(signingSecret, X-Orbit-Timestamp + "." + rawBody)>`.

Reject timestamps more than 300 s off and compare in constant time.

servers.description: The integration's HTTPS base URL configured in Orbit.

post.summary: Read the context of one verified customer (customer_context.read).

parameters.name: X-Orbit-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds when Orbit signed the request.

parameters.name: X-Orbit-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp, a dot and the raw body.

200.description: The customer's context. Unknown values are null; a null amount is never 0.

400.description: Invalid request or unsupported schema version (`invalid_request`, `unsupported_version`).

401.description: Missing or wrong bearer token or signature (`unauthenticated`).

403.description: The integration may not read this customer (`access_denied`).

404.description: No customer with this external user id (`customer_not_found`).

422.description: The product does not accept this identity as verified (`identity_not_verified`).

503.description: The product or its data is temporarily unavailable (`service_unavailable`).

504.description: The gateway's call to the product timed out (`upstream_timeout`).

integrationToken.description: Per-integration token issued for Orbit. Required together with the signature.

requestId.description: Unique per lookup; echoed in X-Orbit-Request-Id.

integrationId.description: Opaque id of the Orbit integration; selects the provider's routing.

id.description: The product's own user id, exactly as it signs it for the Orbit widget.

method.description: The product's backend signed this user id for the Orbit widget.

verifiedAt.description: When Orbit verified the link to this user id.

include.description: Sections to return; all when absent.

CustomerContextRequest.title: CustomerContextRequest
CustomerContextRequest.description: Orbit's lookup of one verified customer. Carries no e-mail, name or Orbit tenant id.

id.description: The product's own user id, exactly as it signs it for the Orbit widget.

key.description: Opaque, stable key chosen by the provider. Orbit never interprets it.

currentPeriodEnd.description: End of the paid or trial validity.

state.description: scheduled: ends at effectiveAt (e.g. at period end). effective: already ended.

subscription.description: null exactly when freshness.availability.subscription is not `available`.

key.description: Opaque, stable key chosen by the provider. Orbit never interprets it.

state.description: The effective state for this customer now.

reason.description: Why a feature is denied; null when granted.

entitlements.description: null exactly when freshness.availability.entitlements is not `available`.

key.description: Opaque, stable key chosen by the provider. Orbit never interprets it.

limit.description: Non-negative quantity, or null when unknown. null never means 0.

used.description: Non-negative quantity, or null when unknown. null never means 0.

remaining.description: Non-negative quantity, or null when unknown. null never means 0.

unlimited.description: true: no limit applies. null: unknown.

resetsAt.description: Next reset, or null when unknown or never.

usage.description: null exactly when freshness.availability.usage is not `available`.

dataAsOf.description: Age of the underlying product data, when known.

maxAgeSeconds.description: How long Orbit may show this snapshot.

subscription.description: available: the section holds data. unavailable: the provider could not read it now. not_applicable: the product has no such concept. not_requested: excluded by `include`.

CustomerContext.title: CustomerContext
CustomerContext.description: Product-neutral snapshot of one verified customer. Unknown values are null; a null amount is never 0.

detail.description: Short diagnostic text. Never customer data.
